scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

exact_constructor.storage: Fresh caller-owned suitably aligned complete SigInfo; zero every byte including representation/padding before references or consumer copy
exact_constructor.sigchld_si_pid: thread.tid as existing CInt, NOT proc.pid or parent pid
exact_constructor.sigchld_si_status: thread.exit_status after branch assigns SIGTRAP = 5; no wait-status encoding shift
exact_constructor.remaining_bytes: All zero: si_uid, si_utime, si_stime, outer/payload padding and unused union extent

findings: arch/x86_64/kernel/syscall.c:2195 declares independent local info; pending is transferred to ptrace_recvsig or freed before sigcommon writer unlock and default switch. Pending producer bytes cannot initialize this separate local. SIGTRAP branch at2259 uses it in both notifications without initialization.

SIGTRAP untraced path still jumps to original core handling. Traced path sets thread.exit_status=SIGTRAP and thread.status=PS_TRACED. Main-thread path locks process.update_lock, writes group_exit_status=SIGTRAP/proc.status=PS_DELAY_TRACED, unlocks, then rereads parent pid and calls do_kill; nonmain path reads report pid, do_kill then rereads report_proc waitq and wakes. Existing schedule follows notification. Constructor does not authorize reordering these effects or adding another wake.

Existing C ptrace_report_signal fallback at1810 and selected Rust ptrace_report_signal_body_result at22340 explicitly zero complete object then set SIGCHLD/CLD_TRAPPED/tid/exit_status. This is an appropriate source precedent for the new parent trapped notification fields. Do not wholesale call that helper: its locking/debugregister/signalflags/wake behavior differs from original default SIGTRAP.

Selected arch_do_kill_pending_enqueue_result:32738 copies full size_ofSigInfo into new owned pending under original pending lock; coalescing returns without copying and allocation failure returns ENOMEM. Fresh complete initialization is required for every noncoalesced successful enqueue. Synchronous do_kill tail no longer receives the caller info pointer after enqueue; pending owns copied bytes.

ABI source uses reprC SigInfo with integer fields/plain pointer-capable union and explicit padding; allzero is valid for selected SIGCHLD child arm. C public signal.h has corresponding child int pid/uid/status and long utime/stime. This source correspondence does not replace missing actual selected ABI20 witness.

Proposed fresh notification is an intentional ordinary functional correction to undefined info input. No undefined parity, old pending payload reuse, oracle normalization, source default selection or native acceptance is inferred.
unresolved_lifetime_constraints: Current thread and proc must remain valid at each original state store, main-thread comparison, lock/unlock and notification; retain existing currentCPU/interrupt/scheduler exclusions without widening locks.

Parent/report_proc pointers must retain genuine existing ownership through pid read and synchronous do_kill; nonmain report_proc must still be live when reread after callback for waitq. No caching across callbacks, invented reference, null fallback or added lifetime extension.

Fresh info storage stays aligned/live/fully initialized throughout synchronous do_kill and all recursive process/group routing until return; provider must copy or synchronously consume and never retain stack pointer. Do not access freed/transferred pending info.

Read thread.tid and thread.exit_status at explicit construction point after SIGTRAP state assignment, before either notify; any concurrent writer safety remains existing thread ownership obligation, not proven by initialization.

Genuine selected C/Rust SigInfo/Thread/Process layout and callback ABI20, actual provider/default uniqueness and applicable lock/lifetime/native proof remain open. No GS/TSS/xstate/service restriction disposition here.
